about: One row per animal morph. A morph hides Beast Boy for its duration while the game's own tag-assist fighter (real model from the player's Injustice 2 install) performs the attack, then Beast Boy reappears.

_verify.padButton: Steam discussion app/627270: Multiverse assist is called with RS (right stick click)
_verify.key: Steam discussion app/627270: keyboard P calls the assist
_verify.hiddenScale: I2Hook README: player scale is visual only
_verify.durationMs: UNVERIFIED: must match Grodd assist on-screen time in game
_verify.cooldownMs: UNVERIFIED: must match the game's assist cooldown so Beast Boy never vanishes without the gorilla
